questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Choose static fictitious field replacement for the supplied realistic test-copy requirement; no vault alone does not exclude every tokenisation design or prove anonymity.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD fictitious replacement of names/identifiers as complete anonymisation, absence of a vault as absence of linkage, or every tokenisation scheme as requiring a lookup vault. m305WholeScopeHold.contentQualification: HOLD precise whole-item 2.3 assessment scope: the offered decision chooses a mitigation, whereas 2.3 is vulnerability explanation. objective23FeedbackHolds.contentQualification: HOLD reflected and DOM-based XSS as universally exclusive categories, all stored XSS as server-only or every visitor exposure, HttpOnly/CSP as universal XSS prevention, and every XSS as cookie theft. Missing object/action authorisation supports the decision; random IDs alone do not repair it. The retained all-parameters mass-assignment correction is overbroad and precise contrast is held. HOLD a symlink alone as TOCTOU, an uncoordinated lock/file descriptor as universal prevention, or directory traversal as requiring literal dot-dot-slash. objective24HeldDispositions.contentQualification: HOLD whole numbered 2.4 assessment scope: the keyed decision selects a mitigation rather than analyzes an indicator. One combined choice supplies no independently keyed freshness components. Old attack/mitigation pair and metadata-only DNSSEC/MITM references do not establish those skills or tooltip delivery; no verifier or replay defense executes.

Correlate with m259 and retain prior DDoS glossary/actor holds.
